followUps.answer: There are some disadvantages of reading e-books, such as eye strain and screen distractions.
followUps.example: For example, when I read an e-book on my phone before bed, social media notifications often distract me and make my eyes tired.
followUps.q: Do e-books have any disadvantages or negative impacts?

followUps.reason: Although digital e-books are easy to carry on trips, many readers still love paper books because they let us dive into the world of a book without eye strain or battery worries.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think individuals, schools, and the government should continue to use and support e-books in a smart way.
followUps.example: For example, schools can offer free e-book libraries for students, while reminding them to take short breaks to rest their eyes.
followUps.q: Should people continue to use and promote e-books in the modern world?
followUps.reason: To support this positive change, citizens should use modern technology in a smart, responsible way, and using e-books also reduces paper waste and helps protect the environment.

hint.coreTopic: benefits of a cashless society

followUps.answer: There are some reasons why older people do not want to use mobile banking, such as fear of making mistakes and low tech skills.

followUps.q: Why do some elderly citizens feel reluctant to adopt digital and mobile banking payments?

followUps.answer: There are some safety risks in a cashless society, such as online scams and stolen bank data.
followUps.example: For instance, if someone clicks a fake bank message on their phone, hackers can quickly steal money from their e-wallet.
followUps.q: What are the potential privacy and cybersecurity concerns in a completely cashless economy?
followUps.reason: Sharing private details online or clicking strange links allows cyber criminals to steal bank accounts and personal identities easily, and a power or internet cut can stop all payments.

followUps.answer: I think banks and the government should improve rural internet, lower service fees, and teach local people how to pay safely.
followUps.example: For example, local banks can send staff to village markets to help farmers set up free QR payment codes and explain how to avoid online scams.
followUps.q: How should banks and governments support people in rural regions to access cashless services?
followUps.reason: From a broader perspective, authorities should invest in better network facilities, offer free training workshops, and make simple apps so everyone can easily use cashless services.

hint.coreTopic: childhood obesity, its causes and solutions

followUps.answer: There are some main reasons why childhood obesity is more common in modern cities, such as fast-food habits, busy parents, and lack of play spaces.
followUps.example: For example, many city kids sit in front of a tablet after school while eating fried chicken and drinking sweet milk tea.
followUps.q: Why has childhood obesity become increasingly common in modern cities?
followUps.reason: Fast food is convenient for busy people in modern-day society, and city children spend too much time indoors on screens instead of running outside.

followUps.answer: I think parents and schools should work closely together to teach healthy eating habits and organize regular sports activities.
followUps.example: For instance, schools can ban sugary sodas on campus and hold afternoon football or badminton clubs for students.
followUps.q: What role should parents and schools play in preventing obesity among children?
followUps.reason: Children often lack self-control, so parents should prepare healthy family meals at home while schools offer fun PE classes and limit junk food in canteens.

followUps.answer: There are some serious health problems that childhood obesity can cause later in life, such as heart disease, diabetes, and joint pain.
followUps.example: For example, obese teenagers often feel tired easily when walking upstairs and may need regular medical care for high blood pressure in adulthood.
followUps.q: What long-term health problems can childhood obesity lead to in adulthood?
followUps.reason: Being overweight for many years weakens physical fitness and increases the risk of common illnesses as children grow into adults.
